Name: Borderless Mode Fix (True Windowed Borderless Mode)
Author: Murgonja
Description:
[size=5]About the mod[/size]
This mod forces the game into Windowed mode upon launch, and then scales the window to your monitor's resolution which results in a true borderless windowed experience. (The game title bar is also removed on launch)

You will be able to seamlessly alt-tab from and to the game without the black screen appearing.

This can also be done by using external apps like Windowed Borderless Gaming, but with this mod, you don't have to run anything in the background and the Borderless Windowed mode automatically sets every time upon game launch.

This is a very lightweight mod. Besides the borderless windowed mode being set automatically upon game launch, you can also set a keybind in config.json to trigger it manually (or set the keybind through the game if you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed).
